review.limitations: V2 nonblind AI_PROXY uses both actual finite sections and two per-pixel depth views of the identical geometry. Visual seat adoption is not indexed joining, global absence of intersection, an entire sealed boundary, or proof that all overhangs are valid. Two central cuts can miss off-plane features. No unique source-style requirement. Original painter-sorted V1 images and judgments remain unchanged and separately versioned.
review.notes: Depth rendering exposes the curved C as the cantilever chair's upper sitting surface, with the generated back and front slab organized around this level. Rear overhang and local edge gaps still prevent a full joining claim. The raised triangular back-cap flap is a visible folded-layer quality concern in both stages.
